report_hints: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?

The protagonist defeated the robot through a surprise attack on its power core
A malfunction in the mech forced the pilot to seek the astronauts' help
The protagonist confronted the robot and discovered its pilot was his clone
The team activated an emergency defense system that trapped both factions
Option B involves a hidden map and ancient civilizations which are abstract narrative elements not easily captured in a single action frame; treat as low visual priority
The question asks for the missing interval between beginning and ending; ensure retrieved frames show transitional actions or revelations rather than just static states

For Option E, look for visual similarity between the protagonist and the revealed entity to support the clone theory
